  repair 1: test_bug: The test's setup is out of order and its setup calls are unawaited. Rejecting the W-9 sets the vendor to `rejected` (review.py: `if not approve: vendor.status = VendorStatus.REJECTED`), so the two approvals of the insurance certificate and contract that follow the rejection hit `decide()` while the vendor is no longer in review and get 409 `vendor_not_in_review`. Those calls are written as `expectStatus(...)` without `await`, so their failures are never reported and the test only fails later at the final approve. The scenario's precondition is that the other documents were already approved before the W-9 was sent back, so the approvals must come first. Each setup call also needs `await` so its status is checked (PW-13). Corrected order: approve insurance and contract, reject the W-9, upload and wait for the replacement, resubmit (the vendor was sent back and is editable, per "A vendor that was sent back can be edited again"), then approve the replacement and assert approved status and the audit event.
